SeriesScreen.title: Series
SeriesScreen.description: Every series of every site, and the works you said to be one series. A work is of one series: the sites' series of one work are one series, its works in the order the sites number them.
Series.saidHint: You said this work and another are one series
Series.takeOutHint: Take the work out of the series you put it in; a site's series keeps its works
Series.notSeen: Its page was never opened: known by the works naming it
Series.site: Open the series on the site
Series.orderHint: Every site's numbers held together by pairs: a work goes before another as most sites say
Series.none: No site's series: the works you said to be one series
